item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
So, I'm downvoting this, but upvoting the Incident (though I feel like the numbering of the report should be change to Incident 307-1 or something).

  1. I agree with previous comments regarding this being Euclid, not Keter.
  2. Also agree with the whole "incineration" vs "burn" thing.
  3. Random Agent (a self-insert, for one, who is also an Agent in charge of research on 307 just because he found it…?) running into it randomly on a nature hike or something AND wasn't attacked by it himself…? Needs to go.
  4. And 307 is seemingly all over the place and hasn't destroyed the world already, let alone been noticed by anyone else?

Needs a slight edit for tone, take out the self insert (I can see how tempting it is to do that, though), throw incineration in there, and make it a Recovery Team or MTF (Gamma-9 "Weed Pullers" or something) after mysteeeeeeerious reports of people and local pets just up and disappearing near BLACKBOX, TN. We don't have enough stuff being found in Tennessee. The Carolinas are always getting all the loving.1

Y'know what? If no one else wants to pick this up, I feel like I've got enough tumbling around in my head to do a rewrite myself… If I'm able to get to my computer later, I might throw something together in my sandbox (a comment is one thing, but more extensive editing would just be too much to attempt on my tablet). I know it's currently in the positives, but I'm guessing if traffic was somewhat guided or pushed here, it would very quickly drop. I of course won't make any of these changes to the article itself without permission.

Regardless, working on a rewrite (whether it's used or not) would be good practice for writing a SCP. I'd really like to do one some day, but I'm always afraid of ideas not being good enough, aside from also worrying about accidentally "copying" a scip I haven't read yet. lol

Footnotes
1. This is not based on any actual research, or even really any perceived bias of particular States within the Union getting more scips than any other States. =P

item.content:encoded:
Yeah, this has that Old SCP smell (just like that "new car" smell, only different, and bad). It's not a bad idea, but needs cleanup. A few things:

Tone in general, as Djoric said.

Please get rid of the "Agent randomly saw it" bit. One of my pet peeves. Yep, I took a walk in the park last week and hey, wow, anomalous carnivorous plants all over the damn place.

The idea that this thing makes some kind of "plant people" out of its victims…OK, cool. The idea that the Foundation burned them immediately, instead of containing them for a while to see what interesting thing they might do…lame. This is where there was a chance to write up a really good effect, and the author threw it away.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
As much as I enjoy the concept…

Further examination has revealed the prevalence of the plant throughout North America.

This really isn't the sort of thing that could be loose all over in the wild for a long time without attracting some sort of widespread attention. "Oh, a crazy, physics-defying carniverous plant. My, would you look at that. They seem to be all over the country."

There also doesn't appear to be anything checking its growth or hunger; it would depopulate and cover surrounding areas extremely quickly. It sounds like a fairly dangerous completely uncontained Keter from the way I'm reading it. I'm surprised nobody else has already said this.
